feature_name: Add vscode-uri dependency to VS Code extension
description: Add the vscode-uri package as a dependency to the VS Code extension package to ensure proper functionality. This dependency is required for URI handling within the extension but is currently missing from the package manifest.
functional_requirements: Add vscode-uri as a dependency in the VS Code extension's package.json file
Update the lockfile to include the new dependency with appropriate version
Ensure the dependency is properly installed and available for the extension's build process
